launch_program_local_multithreading: launch a launchpad program using multiple threads with optional node serialization
run_thread_handler: run threads for all program groups and wrap them in a worker manager
check_nodes_serializable: check if python nodes in a program group are serializable before launching
initialize_node_context: initialize launch context for all nodes with LOCAL_MULTI_THREADING launch type
connect_input_handles: connect input handles of all nodes to their corresponding program groups
